title: Uwavuzwe mu rugo rw'Intumwa
intro: Mu rugo rw'intumwa ya nyuma, habayeho umuntu inkuru ye bwite yabaye isomo ry'Imana ku bizera bose. Ubuzima bw'uyu muntu bwari bufitanye isano rya bugufi n'itegeko rihindura imibereho ryahinduye imigenzo y'abaturage iteka ryose, bigaragaza impinduka ikomeye mu buryo ukwizera kwasobanuraga umuryango n'uko umuntu ari umwe.
clues: Izina ryanjye ryari rifitanye isano n'umuryango w'icyubahiro, ariko ukuri kw'ikirenga nyuma kwaje gusobanura neza isano nyakuri ry'ukwemera.
Nahawe inema nyinshi na Allah n'intumwa ye, inema yatangajwe mu gitabo ku mugaragaro.
Ubuzima bwanjye bw'ishyingiranwa bwabaye ikizamini gikomeye cyahinduye iteka uko abantu babonaga imibanire y'abakiri bato.
Ni njyewe urubanza rwe bwite rwatumye habaho itegeko ry’Imana ryemerera Intumwa gushaka umugore nyuma yo kugenda.
Mu nkuru yanjye, itandukaniro riri hagati y'umuryango w'abavutse ku mubiri n'uwatoranijwe ryagaragajwe neza ku bisekuru byose.
Ni njye wenyine mu bo tungana izina ryanjye rigaragara neza mu ihishurwa riheruka, atari nk'umuhanuzi, ahubwo nk'umugaragu wageragejwe kandi wubahwa.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
